duration.text: The Computer system Organization at Shanghai JiaoTong University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6319 USD/per year ￥ 45500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be over 18 years in age 2. Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. HSK level 6 or above 4. Recommendation from at least two teachers with titles of or above associate-professor 5. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 6. Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and regulations of the university. Respect Chinese social customs and habits. 7. Be in good health condition
